## Types

```ts
type Barrier = {
  arrive: () => Promise<void>;
  skip: () => void;
  arrived: number;
  skipped: number;
};
type BurstResult = {
  responses: Response[];
  statuses: Readonly<Record<number, number>>;
};
type ClearableTable = // EntityTableMeta, a built table, or a plain table name string.
  | string
  | {
    tableName?: string;
  }
  | unknown
;
type ConsoleSpyLike = {
  mock: {
    calls: ReadonlyArray<ReadonlyArray<unknown>>;
  };
};
type E2EGeneratorOptions = {
  tenantPlaceholder?: string;
};
type E2ETestSpec =
  | {
    kind: "list-renders";
    screenQn: string;
    title: string;
    urlPath: string;
  }
  | {
    kind: "list-has-fixture-row";
    screenQn: string;
    title: string;
    urlPath: string;
    writeHandlerQn: string;
    fixture: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    identifyingValue: string;
  }
  | {
    kind: "edit-validates-required";
    screenQn: string;
    title: string;
    urlPath: string;
    requiredFields: string[];
  }
  | {
    kind: "edit-save-persists";
    screenQn: string;
    title: string;
    urlPath: string;
    listUrlPath?: string;
    fills: EditFillOp[];
    identifyingValue: string;
    identifyingField: string;
  }
;
type EditFillOp =
  | {
    kind: "fill";
    field: string;
    value: string;
  }
  | {
    kind: "check";
    field: string;
    value: boolean;
  }
  | {
    kind: "select";
    field: string;
    value: string;
  }
;
type EventStoreWriteScope = {
  tenantId?: TenantId; // Tenant of the acting system user and of the tenant-bound db; defaults to the system tenant.
  streamTenantId?: TenantId; // Address a stream that lives on another tenant than the actor's.
};
type EventStoreWriteTarget = {
  table: ExecutorArgs[0];
  entity: ExecutorArgs[1];
  entityName: string;
};
type LateBoundHolder<T> = {
  set(value: T): void; // Store the concrete value.
  get(): T; // Fetch the concrete value or throw if set() hasn't been called yet.
  isReady(): boolean; // True after set() has been called.
};
type ManualClock = Clock & {
  set(instant: Temporal.Instant): void;
  advance(step: ClockStep): void;
};
type MutableMasterKeyProvider = MasterKeyProvider & {
  replace(next: MasterKeyProvider): void;
};
type ParsedSetCookie = {
  value: string;
  raw: string;
};
type RecordingProvider = ObservabilityProvider & {
  spans: RecordedSpan[];
  metricEvents: MetricEvent[];
  spansByName(name: string): RecordedSpan[];
  spansByTraceId(traceId: string): RecordedSpan[];
  reset(): void;
};
type SseFrame = {
  event: string | undefined;
  data: string;
  id: string | undefined;
};
```
